title: hymenopappus scabiosaeus var. riograndensis
intro: Hymenopappus scabiosaeus var. riograndensis, commonly known as Rio Grande fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Hymenopappus scabiosaeus var. riograndensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
